Subject: Novus Labs — security intake & questionnaire (post-demo follow-up)

Elena — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so our security team can kick off the questionnaire:  

- Novus uses PII + health-adjacent product data across EU and US customers (you mentioned HIPAA adjacency but not full covered entity).
- You asked for SOC 2 report and a short note on data residency options (we have hosted and VPC/private options).
- Next steps: 1) please share the vendor security intake form you want us to complete (SIG/CAIQ/custom), 2) any priority evidence (SOC 2, penetration test report), 3) timeline target for procurement.

I've attached a prefill we typically use to speed SIG completion. If you prefer we fill a custom PDF, send the form and we'll prioritize.  

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Proposed internal contacts (cc'd): Vivek — security SME for encryption/comms; Monica — vendor onboarding and procurement lead.

Thanks — I'll wait for the form and any initial deadlines.

— Ben

Thanks Ben — great session. We're ready to start the formal intake. Attaching our intake form (PDF) and a short vendor checklist. A few answers up-front:  

- Target procurement window: we aim to complete vendor review by 2026-10-01.
- Data types: system will process deidentified PHI and some re-identifiable user metadata (we'll provide examples on the form).
- Compliance expectations: SOC 2 Type II preferred; if not available, SOC 2 roadmap + compensating controls accepted.

I've attached the Novus Vendor Intake PDF. Please confirm who on your side will own each section (security, privacy, legal).

Attachments: Novus_SIG_Request_Form.pdf (pdf)

Best,

Subject: Fwd: Novus Labs — security intake & questionnaire (post-demo follow-up)

Forwarding Novus' intake form. They want the vendor review done by 2026-10-01 — tight but doable. Can you confirm the following and I'll assign sections:  

1) SOC 2 status: do we have a current Type II? If not, what is the latest audit period and planned Type II date?
2) Encryption at rest: which KMS options do we list for Private vs Hosted? Any HSM/KMS vendor names we should surface?
3) Data residency: default hosting regions and whether we can commit EU-only storage for their account (and any lead time for that).
4) Pen test evidence: latest external pentest date and whether summary is shareable.

I'll use the redwood prefill to speed answers, but want to avoid giving partial/conflicting responses. Vivek/Monica — please add any missing asks before I push back to Novus.

— Ben

On Sep 14, 2026, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novuslabs.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — great session. We're ready to start the formal intake...
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novuslabs.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Novus Labs — security intake & questionnaire (post-demo follow-up)

Ben — quick answers and what I'll own:  

1) SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II report covering the control period 2025-06 through 2026-05. We expect our next Type II report to cover through 2027-05; audit kickoff scheduled Q1 2027. We'll provide a redacted copy of the 2025-06→2026-05 report for vendor review.

2) Encryption: Hosted default: AES-256 at rest with cloud provider-managed keys; we can offer customer-managed keys (KMS) on Dedicated and Private deployments. Supported KMS integrations: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault; we also support HSM-backed keys via Bring-Your-Own-HSM for Private installs.

3) Data residency: For Hosted, we can create an EU-resident tenant (lead time ~3–4 weeks for full data residency setup and compliance checks). Dedicated/VPC can be deployed to customer's preferred region; on-prem options available with longer lead time. We'll note these as commitments with lead times on the intake.

4) Pen test: External pentest performed 2026-04 (summary available; full report requires NDA). We can share executive summary and remediation plan.

I'll take the security section and fill encryption, SOC 2, pen-test, and vuln management. Monica — can you coordinate procurement and the legal section (contracts/DPAs) and confirm pricing band for Dedicated if they ask?

Vivek
Sr. Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novuslabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, security@novuslabs.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus Labs — security intake & questionnaire (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks for the speedy responses, Vivek — that covers most of our blockers. A couple of clarifying points before we mark procurement as green:  

- SOC 2 redacted copy is perfect — please include the scope line items (which services were in-scope) in the intake.
- For EU tenant lead time, can you confirm the target SLA for failover/latency to EU users? (high level is fine).
- Pen test summary: executive summary + remediation tracker is ideal. We can sign an NDA if necessary for the full report.

Procurement note: we'll route legal/contract to our procurement team when we have the intake answers. If you can target the security and legal sections by EOD Friday 2026-09-18, we'll slot you for the procurement committee review on 2026-09-24.

Thanks — Elena
Head of Platform Partnerships | Novus Labs
